No. Hansen/UMD mapped tree-cover loss of about 81.3 ha in 2021, which is roughly 2.2% of the 3,643.5 ha property. The rest of the property showed no mapped loss of that kind, apart from 37.3 ha of loss in patches under 0.5 ha, which falls below the minimum event size and isn't counted.

The loss is corroborated. A later year (up to 2025) was observed, and the JRC 2020 forest reference agrees on 98% of the affected area. According to the MGAP 2021 map, about 68.1 ha was planted forest (Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda), 13.2 ha was outside mapped forest, and none was native forest.

This evidence doesn't show that deforestation or land-use change occurred, since the loss could be plantation harvest. It also doesn't establish the cause, legality, responsible party, or any compliance finding.
